mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY ( COMMU_NUM, BOARD_NUM, EMPLOYEE_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, COMPANY_NUM, COMMU_SUBJECT, COMMU_REGIST, COMMU_UPDATE, COMMU_CONTENTS, COMMU_IMAGE, COMMU_VIEWS, COMMU_GOOD, COMMU_STORE_NAME, COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME, COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME ) VALUES ( COMMUNITY_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{boardNum}, #{employeeNum, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memberNum, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{companyNum, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commuSubject}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{commuContents}, #{commuImageStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, 0, #{commuStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commuOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commuImageOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY SET COMMU_SUBJECT = #{commuSubject}, COMMU_CONTENTS = #{commuContents}, COMMU_UPDATE = SYSDATE, COMMU_IMAGE = #{commuImageStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME = #{commuImageOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COMMU_STORE_NAME = #{commuStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME = #{commuOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE COMMU_NUM = #{commuNum}
mapper.select: SELECT COMMU_NUM, BOARD_NUM, EMPLOYEE_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, COMPANY_NUM, COMMU_SUBJECT, COMMU_REGIST, COMMU_UPDATE, COMMU_CONTENTS, COMMU_IMAGE, COMMU_VIEWS, COMMU_GOOD, COMMU_STORE_NAME, COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME, COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME FROM COMMUNITY ORDER BY COMMU_REGIST DESC

SELECT c.COMMU_NUM, c.BOARD_NUM, c.EMPLOYEE_NUM, c.MEMBER_NUM, c.COMPANY_NUM, c.COMMU_SUBJECT, c.COMMU_REGIST, c.COMMU_UPDATE, c.COMMU_CONTENTS, c.COMMU_IMAGE, c.COMMU_VIEWS, c.COMMU_GOOD, c.COMMU_STORE_NAME, c.COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME, c.COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME, m.MEMBER_NAME AS writerName FROM COMMUNITY c LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON c.MEMBER_NUM = m.MEMBER_NUM WHERE c.BOARD_NUM = #{boardNum} ORDER BY c.COMMU_REGIST DESC

SELECT c.COMMU_NUM, c.BOARD_NUM, c.EMPLOYEE_NUM, c.MEMBER_NUM, c.COMPANY_NUM, c.COMMU_SUBJECT, c.COMMU_REGIST, c.COMMU_UPDATE, c.COMMU_CONTENTS, c.COMMU_IMAGE, c.COMMU_VIEWS, c.COMMU_GOOD, c.COMMU_STORE_NAME, c.COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME, c.COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME, m.MEMBER_NAME AS writerName FROM COMMUNITY c LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON c.MEMBER_NUM = m.MEMBER_NUM WHERE c.COMMU_NUM = #{commuNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_LIKE (target_type, target_id, member_num) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{memberNum})
mapper.select: SELECT commu_num AS commuNum, commu_subject AS commuSubject, commu_regist AS commuRegist, commu_good AS commuGood FROM community ORDER BY commu_good DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
